name: Databricks Platform & Workspace Operations
description: Workspace administration, compute models (all-purpose clusters, SQL warehouses, serverless), RBAC, environment/workspace strategy and platform operations.

name: Unity Catalog, Security & Governance
description: Unity Catalog architecture (metastores, catalogs, schemas), grants model, lineage, row filters/column masks, audited access, SCIM and migration from the hive_metastore.

name: Delta Lake & Lakehouse Architecture
description: Delta Lake internals (ACID, time travel, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, liquid clustering), medallion architecture and lakehouse design patterns.

name: Spark Data Engineering & Delta Live Tables
description: PySpark fundamentals, job/partition/shuffle mechanics, performance troubleshooting, Delta Live Tables pipelines, expectations and data quality engineering.

name: Structured Streaming & Real-Time Processing
description: Structured Streaming sources/sinks, triggers, watermarking and late data, state management, exactly-once patterns and streaming architecture.

name: SQL & Performance Optimisation
description: ANSI SQL and Databricks SQL fluency, warehouse sizing/scaling, Photon, query tuning, statistics and incremental modelling (SCD, merge patterns).

name: Cloud Infrastructure & Networking
description: Cloud fundamentals across AWS/Azure/GCP as they apply to Databricks: VPC/VNet design, secure cluster connectivity/PrivateLink, storage access patterns, identity plumbing and cost controls.

name: Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement
description: End-to-end solution design, requirements discovery, trade-off analysis, migration strategy, executive communication and acting as a trusted technical advisor inside a customer account.
